name: meta-optimization-manager
description: meta-optimization-manager CLI surface. Single source of truth for the command groups (coverage/focus/convergence/trials): schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the proto service descriptors at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest.

groups.name: coverage
groups.description: Readiness scoreboard — per-projection coverage joined live against the owners

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the readiness scoreboard (per-projection coverage + denominator-confidence + empirical trend)

flags.name: projection
flags.description: Restrict to one projection (answer|validate|guide); omit for all

commands.name: list-cells
commands.description: List the denominator grid cells with live status applied

commands.name: explain-cell
commands.description: Explain one cell (by namespaced id <projection>/<id>) with its provenance

commands.name: validate-docs
commands.description: Validate the space docs themselves (self-honesty gate, OT-P0-004); exits non-zero on an ERROR issue

flags.name: projection
flags.description: Restrict to one projection (answer|validate|guide); omit for all

groups.name: focus
groups.description: Ranked next-best gaps — impact × importance across all projections + convergence

commands.name: next
commands.description: Show the ranked next-best gaps (impact × importance) with qualitative context

groups.name: gaps
groups.description: The gaps registry — list/show known gaps and store explored approaches

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the gaps registry (live-derived non-NOW cells overlaid with the owned registry)

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show one gap by id with its full qualitative context

commands.name: note
commands.description: Append an explored-but-unbuilt approach to a gap (the one focus write verb)

groups.name: convergence
groups.description: Template & reference-scenario fitness — the four-lens convergence measure + trend

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show per-template four-lens fitness + gold-star reference health across all templates

commands.name: fitness
commands.description: Show the four-lens fitness counts + advisory tier for one template (or all)

flags.name: template
flags.description: Restrict to one template (e.g. react-vite); omit for all

commands.name: trend
commands.description: Show per-replica-cost / coordinated-edit points over the dated fitness-audit records

flags.name: template
flags.description: Restrict to one template; omit for all

groups.name: trials
groups.description: The empirical local-model gate — run the Guide-derived suite in a sandbox and track the trend

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the trial task suite (generated from the Guide space)

commands.name: run
commands.description: Dispatch a task or suite through agent-manager + workspace-sandbox (explicit invocation; expensive; never auto-runs)

flags.name: task
flags.description: Run a single task by id

commands.name: history
commands.description: Show the success-rate / tokens / wall-time trend over time

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show one trial run (verdict, sandbox diff, tokens, time)

commands.name: coverage
commands.description: Show the % of Guide-space tasks that have a live empirical gate
